periods.time: vol-16 ch-004, Stella confronts Or-Gaule in Luxel

name.zh: 露娜艾丝与傀儡王的交易被揭露
name.en: Lunaeyes's bargain with Or-Gaule is revealed

periods.summary: Stella asks Or-Gaule what price Lunaeyes paid to convince him to accept a League-rule representative war instead of letting the Vermillion and Quedland armies slaughter each other. Or-Gaule says he initially rejected her argument that a representative war was more rational. Lunaeyes then offered the spectacle he wanted: if Quedland won and annexed Vermillion, she would personally execute the war criminals, meaning her parents and Stella. Or-Gaule accepted because he wanted to savor the emotional agony of Lunaeyes willingly killing her loved ones. Stella realizes that Lunaeyes endured this private hell to spare the citizens from full-scale war.
periods.cause: Lunaeyes needed a bargaining chip cruel enough to interest Or-Gaule and thereby prevent a national military clash.
periods.outcome: Stella's anger hardens into a vow to burn Or-Gaule to ash and free Lunaeyes from the nightmare bargain.
periods.significance: Reframes the representative war as Lunaeyes's self-sacrifice and gives Stella personal, familial urgency in the final pursuit of Or-Gaule.
